author: nickyeow

english.text: Spaniards love to stroll around in the evening cool.

english.text: I'll do my homework after I watch television.

author: nickyeow

english.text: What was that noise?
What was that sound?

english.text: The teacher told me to stand up.

jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 kei5 hei2 san1。

english.text: Call me up whenever you need my help.

author: nickyeow

english.text: He claims to be a socialist, and yet he has two houses and a Rolls Royce.

english.text: What are the symptoms?

jyutping: jau5 di1 me1 beng6 zing1 gaa3？

english.text: I wonder if she will recognize me after all those years.

jyutping: m4 zi1 gwo3 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 keoi5 zung6 jing6 m4 jing6 dak1 ngo5 ne1？

jyutping: ngo5 cam4 maan5 ngaan5 gwong1 gwong1 dou3 tin1 gwong1 aa3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The people here are particular about what they eat, so even if a restaurant is inexpensive, it'll soon go out of business if the food doesn't taste good.

text: 呢到嘅人對食好講究，所以就算係幾平嘅餐廳都好，如果啲嘢食唔好食，都會好快執笠。

author: kaenif

english.text: I thought that would be a great idea.

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 hai6 hou2 zyu2 ji3。

author: kaenif

english.text: You don't seem to be yourself these days.

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 m4 hai6 hou2 ci5 nei5。

english.text: Can you cancel?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 siu1？

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: It is the first time U.S., British and EU travelers are allowed to visit this sun-kissed nation and its white-washed islands without quarantine requirements since March 2020, when the global pandemic brought international travel to a grinding halt.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 zi6 2020 nin4 3 jyut6 cyun4 kau4 daai6 lau4 hang4 ling6 gwok3 zai3 leoi5 jau4 ting4 deon6 zi1 hau6，mei5 gwok3、jing1 gwok3 tung4 au1 mang4 ge3 leoi5 haak3 sau2 ci3 bei6 wan5 heoi2 hai2 mou5 gim2 jik6 jiu1 kau4 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6 heoi3 ni1 go3 bei2 joeng4 gwong1 sek3 zyu6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 tung4 keoi5 di1 baak6 sik1 ge3 dou2 zeoi6。
text: 呢個係自2020年3月全球大流行令國際旅遊停頓之後，美國、英國同歐盟嘅旅客首次被允許喺冇檢疫要求嘅情況下去呢個畀陽光錫住嘅國家同佢啲白色嘅島嶼。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Do you think, sir, that you could possibly send me on some mission for the paper? I would do my best to put it through and get you some good copy." "What sort of mission had you in your mind, Mr. Malone?" "Well, sir, anything that had adventure and danger in it. I would really do my very best. The more difficult it was the better it would suit me."

jyutping: 「nei5 gok3 dak1，sin1 saang1，nei5 ho2 ji5 paai3 ngo5 heoi3 zap1 hang4 di1 me1 jam6 mou6 heoi3 cyu2 lei5 ne1 fan6 bou3 zi2？ngo5 wui5 zeon6 ngo5 so2 nang4 heoi3 jyun4 sing4，tung4 maai4 lo2 di1 hou2 ge3 fu3 bun2 bei2 nei5。」「nei5 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 jam6 mou6 hai6 me1 leoi6 jing4 ge3，maa5 lung4 sin1 saang1？」「hou2 laa1，sin1 saang1，jam6 ho4 jau5 mou6 him2 tung4 ngai4 him2 ge3 je5。ngo5 zan1 hai6 wui5 zeon6 lik6 heoi3 zou6。jyut6 naan4 jyut6 sik1 hap6 ngo5。」
text: 「你覺得，先生，你可以派我去執行啲咩任務去處理呢份報紙？我會盡我所能去完成，同埋攞啲好嘅副本畀你。」「你心目中嘅任務係咩類型嘅，馬龍先生？」「好啦，先生，任何有冒險同危險嘅嘢。我真係會盡力去做。越難越適合我。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This point bears so much stressing because it is of great practical importance that the reader should understand in what sense he is not to be introduced here to a brand-new language practiced by a handful of eager pioneers, but that the use of this grammar will make him a member of a sizable community of auxiliary-language advocates in all parts of the world who speak and write the same language with more or less striking deviations.

jyutping: ni1 jat1 dim2 hou2 zung6 jiu3，jan1 wai6 duk6 ze2 jing1 goi1 ming4 baak6，hai2 me1 ji3 ji6 soeng6，keoi5 m4 wui5 hai2 ni1 dou6 gaai3 siu6 jat1 zung2 jau4 siu2 sou3 hot3 mong6 ge3 sin1 keoi1 so2 sat6 cin5 ge3 cyun4 san1 jyu5 jin4，ji4 hai6 ni1 zung2 man4 faat3 ge3 si2 jung6，wui5 ling6 keoi5 sing4 wai4 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 jat1 go3 soeng1 dong1 daai6 ge3 fu6 zo6 jyu5 jin4 coeng3 dou6 se5 kwan4 ge3 sing4 jyun4，keoi5 dei6 gong2 tung4 se2 tung4 jat1 zung2 jyu5 jin4，daan6 hai6 pin1 caa1 waak6 do1 waak6 siu2 dou1 hai6 hin2 zyu3 ge3。
text: 呢一點好重要，因為讀者應該明白，喺咩意義上，佢唔會喺呢度介紹一種由少數渴望嘅先驅所實踐嘅全新語言，而係呢種文法嘅使用，會令佢成為世界各地一個相當大嘅輔助語言倡導社群嘅成員，佢哋講同寫同一種語言，但係偏差或多或少都係顯著嘅。
